name: Detalle de Mentón y Mandíbula
algorithm: Chin-Jaw Detail — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes chin and jawline detail for deepfake detection:

1. **Jawline Contorno Extracción**: Facial landmarks along the mandible and chin are tracked per frame to extract the jawline contour. The contour is parameterized using curvature measures, capturing the anatomical shape signature unique to each individual.

2. **Sub - Mandibular Región Análisis**: The region beneath the chin and along the jawline is examined for anatomical detail — skin folds, adipose tissue distribution, and the chin-neck junction. These areas are challenging for deepfake generators because they occur at the boundary of the face-swap region and often exhibit generation artifacts.

3. **Temporal Contorno Estabilidad**: The jawline contour is tracked across frames during speech and head movement. Natural jawlines deform smoothly according to musculoskeletal constraints — the mandible rotates on the temporomandibular joint with predictable kinematics. Deepfake-generated jawlines may exhibit unnatural deformations, warping, or contour instability.

4. **Mandíbula - Neck Límite Coherencia**: The boundary between the face-generated region and the original neck/body is a critical artifact location for face-swap deepfakes. The method analyzes texture, color, and geometric continuity at this boundary — discontinuities indicate where the generated face mesh fails to blend seamlessly with the original body.

5. **Detail Resolución Evaluación**: Fine details along the jawline (stubble, skin texture, moles) are analyzed for rendering quality and temporal consistency. Deepfake generators often produce lower-resolution detail in peripheral face regions (chin, jaw) compared to central regions (eyes, nose), creating a detectable detail gradient.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante chin-jaw detail analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
